FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Whispering Pines Bed & Breakfast is a cozy establishment situated in a tranquil setting, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere for guests. We provide personalized service with a focus on comfort and hospitality, accommodating up to 10 guests in uniquely decorated rooms, each equipped with modern amenities. Our guests enjoy complimentary meals each morning, which are freshly prepared to enhance their stay. With a beautiful garden and well-maintained outdoor areas, visitors can relax and unwind during their time here. We take pride in our commitment to safety and compliance, featuring functioning fire protection systems and adhering to local codes to ensure the well-being of our guests and staff. Our operations are managed closely to guarantee a high level of service and guest satisfaction.

Our bed and breakfast offers 12 charming guest rooms, providing a welcoming atmosphere for travelers seeking a relaxing getaway.
